newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka '96 tea sale average price at record high.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka '96 tea sale average price at record high.

text.p: Sri Lanka's tea auction average price for calender 1996 rose to a record 103.88 rupees per kg from the previous year's high of 72.21 rupees per kg, brokers said on Monday.
The sale average was 65.12 rupees per kg in 1994, they said.
Prices soared mainly because of strong demand for the Indian Ocean island's distinct low grown teas from the Commonwealth of Independent States, Sri Lanka's biggest tea market, they said.
The CIS imported 36.7 million kg of tea from Sri Lanka up to October last year, followed by Turkey and Syria which bought 27.7 million kg and 19.1 million kg respectively, brokers said.
Sri Lanka is the world's biggest tea exporter and exports for 1996 are expected to hit an all-time high of 250 million kg, the Tea Board has said.
The island exported 245 million kg of tea in 1995.
